detailed_descriptions.en: A combination RTS and base builder with a brand new kind of enemy, the Calyx are a group of powerful plant-aliens that, left unchecked, quickly spread to control swathes of the map. As the only remaining occupant of an Avaris Corporation deep-space mining vessel, you’ve arrived in orbit around a barren-looking planet. While you’re trying to get over being frozen for more than a century, you’re dropped to the surface as the ship’s AI outlines your Ore mining targets. Build a power network, set up Harvesters and refine Ore before sending it to orbit for Credits. Build walls and turrets to protect your base. Deploy tanks and artillery to push the Calyx back before it gets too strong. Balance your base’s energy requirements carefully to avoid vital defences being down on power. Secure rare deposits to improve your mining and military capacity. Connect to booster buildings for additional power, mining and healing buffs. Will you establish a strong defence, or attack the Calyx before it spreads too far? Dig in and build a massive force, or adopt a mobile and nimble strategy? There are many ways to defeat the different varieties of Calyx. Start your base wherever you like, experiment and develop your styles of play, and learn to cope with different scenarios. Protect Data Archives to gain Research Points, and use the tech tree to unlock and upgrade more advanced units and buildings. Unlock the Inferno flamethrower and watch the Calyx burn! Build the Unit Workshop and manufacture the Goliath, a massive, multi turret tank, and boost its speed with hover technology. Unlock Orbital technologies and fire a devastating laser beam from orbit. Protect and power communication arrays to access the corporation’s deep space network. Scan the Calyx roots to learn more about how these hostile lifeforms function. Discover new and dangerous Calyx variants as you battle to gain control of the planet and try to find a way home! Take on the Early Access campaign: Tutorial plus 16 maps 5 difficulty levels Tech Tree Earn Research Points and unlock new technologies Upgrade units and buildings Take on 5 species of Calyx Watch out for the evil Liquidator AI! Replay with Skirmish mode: 7 maps 5 difficulty levels Set the number of Calyx roots Choose starting resources Configure available Ore fields Choose your tech level and generate a layout Share the seed with friends so you can play the same challenge Calyx is an Early Access release, and we’d love to hear your thoughts to help shape future development. Please jump into the Discussion Forum, or join our Discord and let us know what you think!

Take on the Early Access campaign:

  • Tech Tree
